subject: Reminder: Upcoming Payment Due
body: Dear [Recipient], This is a friendly reminder that your payment for invoice #123456 is due on [Due Date]. Please ensure that the payment is processed by the due date to avoid any late fees. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team at [Phone Number] or reply to this email. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. Best regards, [Your Name]
